name: Tra Su Cajuput Forest
kicker: Flooded cajuput forest west of the Hậu
summary: Give Trà Sư its own half day. The flooded cajuput forest is 23 km from Châu Đốc. You walk a bamboo bridge and take a motor sampan or a rowed boat through duckweed, lotus, and water hyacinth. The standing gate is 120,000 VND. The boat is a separate 60,000 VND ticket. Confirm that boat price at the gate. A June 2026 price notice was not opened.
getThere: By road, 23 km from Châu Đốc. Minutes are check on arrival.
heroCaption: Cajuput trunks standing in duckweed at Rừng tràm Trà Sư

notice.title: The gate ticket does not include the boat
notice.body: The standing page lists the motorboat and the rowboat at 60,000 VND each, separate from the 120,000 VND gate. The spillway on the Vĩnh Tế canal is a different product. A 30 June 2026 title about a new price notice was not opened. Confirm the boat at the gate.

body: Trà Sư is the wetland west of the Hậu, not a corner of the town market. The rural-tourism page calls it a conservation forest of more than 845 ha, planted from the 1980s on acid lowland. The charms chapter says 850 ha. Both figures stay. You walk the bamboo bridge and take a tắc ráng, a motor sampan, or a rowed three-plank boat through duckweed, lotus, and water hyacinth, watching birds. The Châu Đốc place page says more than 70 bird types.

The operator page calls the bamboo bridge 2.2 km and the longest in Vietnam. The rural-tourism page says the bridge “Vạn bước xuyên rừng” is longer than 3,800 m. Both lengths stay. The on-site guide ticket is capped at 3 hours, at 300,000 VND on the standing price page. A full posted visit length beyond that cap was not printed.

Go in flood season if the water is the point. The English card says September to November. The Vietnamese place page says high water from August to November, and names that window for Trà Sư and the floating villages. Dry-season green is also described. The photographs here are the trunks and the flooded edge. They do not show the boat. Ask for the boat ticket if that is the visit you wanted.

figures.caption: The flooded edge of the cajuput forest, with water in front of the trees
figures.alt: Green flooded forest at Tra Su with still water in the foreground

gettingThere: The charms chapter places the forest 23 km from Châu Đốc. Drive minutes were not printed. Check on arrival. Do not confuse the forest with the spillway trip on the Vĩnh Tế canal, which the operator lists as a separate product.

legs.heading: From Châu Đốc
legs.body: By road, 23 km on the Vietnam Tourism charms chapter. Minutes are check on arrival.

hours: 06:30–18:30 every day, on an operator post for the April 2026 holiday. The price page prints a bicycle loop of 07:00–16:00. A Vietnam Tourism story prints bird decks at 06:00–09:00 and 14:00–19:00. 19:00 sits after the 18:30 close. Confirm the last boat at the gate.
closed: No weekly closing day is printed on the operator post. Check the board on arrival.
admissionNote: Standing prices from 1 November 2024, still the page online on 21 October 2026: gate 120,000 VND a guest. Motorboat 60,000 VND a guest return. Rowboat 60,000 VND a guest. Children under 1.3 m free. From 1.3 m, the adult price. A guide is 300,000 VND for up to 3 hours. The observation-tower fee was not on the standing page. Spillway trips are separate: 500,000 VND a guest for a group under 5, or 100,000 VND a guest return for a group of 5 or more. A 30 June 2026 homepage title about a new price notice was not opened. Confirm the boat add-on at the gate if that notice changed the 2024 table.
